title: Suspension prior to hearing and summary cease and desist timing
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 10.07, if based on affidavits or other documentary evidence the Board determines a licensee is an immediate or serious threat to the public health, safety or welfare, the Board may suspend or refuse to renew a licence pending a final hearing, and a hearing limited to the necessity of the summary action shall be afforded within seven days of the Board's action. Under 247 CMR 10.08(1) the Board or Board President may instead issue a non-disciplinary Cease and Desist Notice or Quarantine Notice, and under 247 CMR 10.08(3) a hearing limited to the necessity of such a notice shall be afforded within 15 business days of the action.
exam_relevance: Tests two different pre-hearing mechanisms with two different hearing clocks and different disciplinary character.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.fact: hearing clock after suspension prior to hearing
numeric_facts.conditions: limited to the necessity of the summary action

numeric_facts.fact: hearing clock after a cease and desist or quarantine notice
numeric_facts.conditions: limited to the necessity of the notice

common_confusions: Summary suspension carries a seven-day hearing clock; a cease and desist notice carries 15 business days.
A cease and desist or quarantine notice is expressly non-disciplinary.
verification_notes: Read verbatim in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 10.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-B authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
